rows.controlled-player-plays-the-chosen-card-: Oracle: the controlled player plays the chosen card if able (CR 723.2, 723.5a, 723.7, 701.18b). Observed in gorge: p0 chose Grizzly Bears from p1's hand, p1 was offered 'Play Grizzly Bears' and the answer was taken, but the Bears never left p1's hand and p1's Forests stayed untapped. Corroboration: XMage (4142596) and a strict Forge (ae39d91530) run that drives p1's two Forests for {G}{G} both play the Bears for p1 with p1's own lands (both Forests tapped, Bears on p1's battlefield, Mountain still in hand), agreeing with the Oracle text. Both engines therefore diverge from gorge.
